description: Explains one rule of the published rubric by its id (as in a failed check's id): its category, severity, what it checks, how many points it is worth, and how to fix it. With a region, as that country weighs it. The full rubric is the resource rubric://default.

region.description: The country the resume was scored as (US, DE, FR, GB, IN, ES, BR, PT, MX, AR, CO, CL), as in a report's locale. Default: none, the published weights.

rule_id.description: A rule id, e.g. from failedChecks.

name: explain_rule
title: Explain a rubric rule
